blocks.text: Organizing your inbox for real estate transactions

Your inbox is the central hub for every property file. You need a system that separates new contracts from routine updates. Start by creating specific folders for each active transaction. Use the Outlook menu to create a folder for each property address. You can also use rules to move emails from specific domains or keywords into these folders. Go to Tools > Rules to set this up. This keeps your main inbox clear for urgent items. If you need help finding the rule settings, ask Lazur to point at the menu.

Missing a contingency date is not an option. You should pin important emails to the top of your list. Right click an email and select Pin. This keeps the message visible until you resolve the issue. You can also use the flag feature to set a follow up date. If you prefer to use your voice, ask Lazur to set a reminder for an email. It can help you draft a follow up message quickly. Use ⌘ + N to start a new email and ⌘ + Return to send it once you are ready.
Using Lazur with Outlook on Mac

Lazur lives in your Mac notch and helps you move faster. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about anything on your screen. If you are lost in the new Outlook interface, ask Lazur where a button is. It will draw a circle around the item. If you need to write a long email to a client, hold fn to dictate your text. It produces clean and formatted content at your cursor. You can also ask Lazur to draft a response based on a specific property situation.

items: ⌘ + N: Create a new email or calendar event.

blocks.text: Real estate work involves many PDFs and signed contracts. Do not let your attachments clutter your desktop. Save them directly into your project folders or cloud storage. Use the attachment icon in the compose window to add files. If you struggle with large files, consider using a link to your cloud drive instead. This keeps your email threads light. If you need to search for an old document, use the search bar at the top. You can use filters to narrow down by sender or date range.

You can change the default font to match your brand. Go to Outlook > Settings > Composing. Choose your font and size. This ensures every email looks professional. You should also set up an email signature. Go to Outlook > Settings > Signatures. Include your contact details and a link to your scheduling tool if you have one. This saves you from typing the same info every time.

Sometimes your calendar or email may stop syncing. Check your internet connection first. If the problem persists, go to the Outlook menu and select Sync Status. This shows you if there is a connection error. You can also try restarting the app. Ensure you are running the latest version of macOS. Microsoft requires macOS 14 or later for the best experience. If you see an error code like -3253, check the Microsoft support site for the latest fix.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons for me in Outlook?
faq.answer: No, Lazur does not click buttons or operate apps for you. It points at things, answers out loud, and helps you get work done by guiding you or dictating text.

faq.question: How do I switch between New and Legacy Outlook?
faq.answer: You can toggle between the two versions using the Outlook menu in the menu bar at the top of your screen.

faq.question: Does Lazur store my email content?
faq.answer: No, Lazur does not store your content. Audio and screenshots are sent to AI providers only while you hold the shortcut and are not used to train models.

faq.question: What macOS version do I need for Outlook?
faq.answer: As of late 2026, you need macOS 14 (Sonoma) or later to receive updates for Microsoft 365 apps.
